[!dolt] skip
# Test bd dep add wiring
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'First issue' --description 'Root dependency' --json
extractid FIRST
bd create 'Second issue' --description 'Depends on first' --json
extractid SECOND

bd dep add $SECOND $FIRST
stdout 'Added dependency'

bd show $SECOND
stdout 'DEPENDS ON'
stdout 'First issue'
